_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); ratings, education and information signals

pit_profile.why: McGraw Hill Financial 'is a leading ratings, benchmarks and analytics provider serving the global capital, commodities and commercial markets' (Item 1); Item 1A: 'Changes in the volume of securities issued and traded in domestic and/or global capital markets and changes in interest rates and volatility in the financial markets could have a material impact on our results of operations', and no risk factor calling a business cyclical; a fall in debt issuance or the markets it serves cuts revenue, and no disruption theme is live for the business on this date

classification.quality_note: McGraw Hill Financial 'is a leading ratings, benchmarks and analytics provider serving the global capital, commodities and commercial markets' (Item 1); Item 1A: 'Changes in the volume of securities issued and traded in domestic and/or global capital markets and changes in interest rates and volatility in the financial markets could have a material impact on our results of operations', and no risk factor calling a business cyclical; a fall in debt issuance or the markets it serves cuts revenue, and no disruption theme is live for the business on this date. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 4.24x; +44% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.82; conservative 2yr +3%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -39.1%/yr (worst year FY04-FY13, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +8.3%/yr (Q1 revenue + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +8.3%/yr (FY04-FY13 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +26.2%/yr (best 2-yr run FY04-FY13); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: MHFI (retrospective, 2014-07-25) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 4.24x (73.1% downside to Bear $22 / +17.3% upside to Bull $96) | Adj composite 2.34 vs market 3.16: gap -0.82 [OVERVALUED] | +44% above the EPP floor $57 (15x FY14E $3.80) | Conservative 2-yr case: +2.7% total (+1.4%/yr) | At 21.5x FY14E the 15% hurdle price $108 sits above the BULL case; Financial Services revenue +4.2% in Q1 2014, forward revenues +4.7% (no FY14 revenue guide in numbers, Q1 2014 growth); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
